stories.title: Hundreds dead and thousands missing after the catastrophic China-Nepal flooding
stories.summary: Casualties continue to rise following Wednesday's devastating floods along the China-Nepal border.

stories.title: After six months of war, Iranians live in fear and hardship
stories.summary: Friday marks exactly six months since the U.S. and Israel launched their war against Iran. We look at how life has changed for Iranians.

stories.title: Judge says the Pentagon can't designate AI company Anthropic a 'supply chain risk'
stories.summary: A federal judge has ruled that the Pentagon violated Anthropic's first amendment rights when it tried to designate the AI company a supply chain risk earlier this year.

stories.title: Scientists collaborated with narwhals to study warming waters in the Arctic
stories.summary: Scientists collaborated with narwhals for a new study to understand human-caused climate change in the Arctic and rising sea levels around the world.

stories.title: Black comic book shop owners across the U.S. team up to increase sales and diversity
stories.summary: NPR's Adrian Florido talks with the co-founder of a newly formed network of independent Black comic book shops across the U.S. They hope to strengthen sales and increase the diversity of comic fans.

stories.title: Social media restrictions on young users: What do the kids say?
stories.summary: We've heard from adults about the new Facebook and Instagram rules, but what are kids saying? Teenage social media users talk about whether the proposed restrictions will have any effect on them.
